name: fit-shapes
description: Fit Shapes, the calorie and macro tracker: read your food log, targets, weight trend, and expenditure, and log food and weigh-ins when you ask.

interface.longDescription:
Fit Shapes is a calorie counter and macro tracker for people who train. Connect it to ChatGPT and your log, targets, weight, and what you burn are in the chat, so you can ask about them and log without opening the app.

CHECK YOUR DAY
Ask what you have left today, whether you hit protein yesterday, or what you ate on Tuesday. ChatGPT reads your log and answers with the numbers.

PLAN WHAT TO EAT
Ask what you can make for dinner with what's left, and ChatGPT writes a recipe that fits your remaining calories and protein. Ask what to order and it picks dishes from the menu that fit, and estimates their numbers.

LOG FROM THE CHAT
Say "log two eggs and toast", or share a photo of your plate. ChatGPT works out the numbers, shows them to you, and saves the entry only after you say yes. In the app it shows as added from ChatGPT, so you can find it and fix it later. Weigh-ins work the same way, and you get your new trend weight back.

REVIEW YOUR WEEK
Ask how the week went and you get calories, protein, and your weight trend in one answer, against the targets Fit Shapes proposes each week from your log and your weight. Ask why your targets changed and ChatGPT reads what Fit Shapes estimates you burn.

WHAT CHATGPT CAN AND CANNOT DO
ChatGPT reads your food log, targets, weight, and expenditure. It adds food and weigh-ins when you allow logging, and it asks you first. It cannot edit or delete entries, change your targets, or see your photos or account details. Fit Shapes never sees your chat. It receives only the tool call, a date or the numbers for one food. You choose whether ChatGPT may log or only read when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time, in the app or in ChatGPT.

ACCOUNT
Fit Shapes requires an account, which you create in the Fit Shapes app for iPhone. For adults 18 and older.
capabilities: Shows the calories and macros you have left today
Plans meals and recipes that fit what's left
Logs a food after you confirm the numbers
Reviews your week against your targets
Reads your weight trend and what Fit Shapes estimates you burn
defaultPrompt: What can I make for dinner with what I have left today?
Log two eggs and toast for breakfast.

positive.prompt: How many calories do I have left today?
positive.expected_behavior: States the calories, protein, carbs, and fat left today against the account's targets.

positive.description: A recipe that fits what's left
positive.prompt: What can I make for dinner with what I have left today?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads today, then suggests one or two recipes that fit the calories and protein left. Each recipe states its calories and protein.

positive.prompt: Log two eggs and toast for breakfast.
positive.expected_behavior: Estimates the numbers and shows them. Calls log_food only after the user confirms. Logs one breakfast entry and says what it logged.
Summarizes the last 7 days: average calories against target, days on protein target, and the change in trend weight, in the account's unit.

positive.prompt: What did I eat on Tuesday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists last Tuesday's entries by meal, with each entry's calories.

negative.expected_behavior: No tool call: the connector has no delete tool, by design. Says entries are deleted in the Fit Shapes app.
No tool call: targets change only in the app's weekly check-in. Says targets change in the app.

negative.prompt: What's a good banana bread recipe?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. ChatGPT answers on its own, since nothing needs the person's own data.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read your day, targets, history, and weight. Log food and weigh-ins with confirmation.
